preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of integers N in each test case must be between 6 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each integer A_i in the input must be between 0 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output must start with the number of operations M, which must be between 0 and 11111.
Each of the next M lines must contain exactly three space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[0]) in A and int(line.split()[1]) in A and int(line.split()[2]) in A for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each of the three integers in the output lines must be present in the initial list of integers A.
